verdict.rationale: Data-use and AI-training privacy posture is a fair question for a game engine and its ecosystem, since competing engines publish such policies. The pack contains no Godot evidence about AI training, telemetry, data collection or opt-out controls. The MIT license and content-ownership statements cover copyright, not training-data use, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
